body.name: Least-favorable-prior conic program
body.construction: For \(\pi\in\Delta(\mathcal K)\), define \(a_{n\omega}=\sum_\kappa\pi_\kappa H_{\kappa n\omega}\), \(h_{n\omega}=\sum_\kappa\pi_\kappa H_{\kappa n\omega}\theta_\kappa\), and \(b_n=\sum_\kappa\pi_\kappa\theta_\kappa^2-\sum_\omega h_{n\omega}^2/a_{n\omega}\), with zero contribution when \(a_{n\omega}=0\); then \(\mathsf Q=\max_{\pi,\underline R}\underline R\) subject to \(\underline R\le b_n\) for every \(n\in\mathcal N\), represented by rotated-cone epigraphs.
